tei:div.tei:p: (ba)༄༅// lnga bsdus sgra gcan gza' lnga dang bcas pa'i rtsis gzhi bzhugs// ༄༅// bla ma dam pa'i zhabs kyi padmor gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// srid dang mya ngan 'das pa'i gtso// thabs dang shes rab mnyam sbyor ba// ye shes sku la phyag 'tshal te// rin chen 'od zer spro bar bya// bsil zer can la zhi ba sogs// 'das pa bsres pa lo dag yin// nyi mas bsgyur la nag sogs sbyin// gnas gnyis 'og ma mig gis bsgyur// 'dod sbyin mda' ros rnyed steng bsre// gnyis 'phel shol yin lhag ma ni// mig gis rnyed pas 'das pa rtogs// steng gi zla dag gnas gsum gzhag /dbus su mig sbyin so yis bsgyur// rtsa bar gcig bsre dus kyis bgo /lhag ma thig les brgyan pa yi// steng nas gcig phab drug cu la// sbyangs lhag gza' yi chu srang yin// thob la gzugs bsre dbus su sbyangs// drug cus bgos lhag chu tshod do// nor la bzhi bsre steng du sbyin// thub pas bgos pa'i lhag ma gza'// zla dag gnas gnyis 'og ma la// zla ba mi bdag rnams bsres nas// dus nyis bgos lhag cha shas yin// steng la me bsre mig gis bsgyur// thob pa byin la klu lag gis// bgos pa'i lhag ma tshogs su 'gyur// gnas gsum dbus ma drag pos bsgyur// rtsa bar bdun bsre so dgus dbye// lhag ma mkha' ros bsgyur ba la// so dgus phye la rnyed pa des// steng nas gcig phab drug cu la// sbyangs lhag skar ma'i chu srang yin// thob pa gong mar mda' bsres pas// dbus su spyi bzhin drug cus bgo /lhag ma chu tshod steng ma ni// mig gis bsgyur la thob pa bsre// 'khor los bgos lhag skar ma'o// gza' la gcig sbyin dbyu gur so// chu srang nas ni bcud bri zhing*// tshogs su gnyis bsre cha shas gcig /skar mar mig dang chu tshod drag /gzugs sam lag pas chu srang nas// 'brid pa zla re 'byed pa yin// nyin re'i nges pa btsal ba'i phyir// gza' la tshes sbyin dbyu gur dbrog

/tshogs su tshes sbyin bcu bzhis bgo /thob pa mnyam sbyin mi mnyam dor// lhag mas zla rkang gzung bya ste// 'byung dbang mda' sde me mig gzugs// bzlog pa dang bcas ma nu'i gnas// 'di dang nyi ma gza' lnga la'ang*// mtshams ma 'das na zos zin dang*// 'das na bza' rgyu'i chu tshod rnams// bsdoms la rkang pa'i 'og tu gzhag /yang dag rgyu bas cha shas bsgyur// dus nyis thob pa de rtsar gzhag /drug cus bsgyur la rnyed chu srang*// drug gis bsnun nas thog pa dbugs// rkang pa'i dbyu gur yang dag rgyus// mtshams ma 'das na sbyin pa dang*// 'das na rim bzhin sbyang bar bya// des ni gza' yi longs spyod du// sbyin dor sngar gyi mtshan mas shes// tshes grangs gnas gnyis steng ma ni// chus bsgyur 'og ma dus lag gis// bsgrel la mkha' ros thob steng sbyin// drug cus thob pa rgyu skar te// rim bzhin nyi longs spyod du sbyin// de nyid gnas gnyis g.yon phyogs kyi// skar mar drug dang chu tshod nas// zhe lngas dbri ste 'khor lo phyed// sbyin dor rim min byang du bgrod// sbyin dor med rim lho bgrod do// skar gnas drug cus bsgyur la bsre// mda' yon zlas rnyed nyi rkang bzung*// dus chu bse ru bzlog dang bcas// ro yi gnas su yang dag rgyus// lhag ma bsgres te mda' yon zlas// rnyed pa'i nor ni de rtsar gzhag /lhag ma drug cus bsgyur la bsre// mda' yon zlas rnyed chu srang ste// drug gis bsnun nas thob pa dbugs// rkang pa'i dbyu gur yang dag rgyus// snga mar sbyin zhing phyi ma la// rim bzhin sbyangs nas de dag gis// gza' dang nyi ma'i longs spyod du// rim min sbyin zhing rim pa sbyang*// nyi dag gnas gnyis g.yon phyogs kyi// skar mar tshes sbyin gnas gzhan du// tshes la ros bsgyur de la gza'i// chu tshod bsres la drug cus bgo /thob pa dang ni lhag ma dang*// gza' yi chu srang dbugs rnams kyis// g.yon gyi skar ma sogs la sbyong*// lhag na 'bud cing ma ldang dbab// nyi zla bsres la 'khor lo yis// phye ba'i lhag ma sbyor ba'o// tshes grangs mig gis bsgyur ba la// zla bas sbyang zhing thub pas bgo

/de yi lhag ma byed pa yin// nyi zla mig dmar gza' lhag dang*// phur bu pa sangs spen pa'o// gza' ni de nyid longs spyod tshes// longs spyod de yang ma 'ongs pa// tha skar bra nye smin drug snar// mgo lag nam so rgyas skag mchu// gre dbo me bzhi nag pa dang*// sa ri sa ga lha mtshams snron// snrubs dang chu stod chu smad dang*// gro bzhin mon gre mon gru dang*// khrums stod khrums smad nam gru ste// skar ma'o sbyor ba nyer bdun ni// sel mdza' tshe ldan skal bzang bzang*// shin tu skrang dang las bzang 'dzin// gzer dang 'bras 'phel nyes rma chen// dga' ba rdo rje dngos grub ltung*// dpa' bo yongs bsnun zhi ba grub// bsgrub bya dge ba dkar po dang*// tshangs pa dbang po sha khon 'dzin// rgyu skar dang ni sbyor ba dag /longs spyod dang bcas 'das pa yin// gdab pa byis can ye shes til// khyim skyes tshong dkris bkra shis dang*// bzhi mdo klu dang mi sdug pa'o// tshes gcig nyin phyed nas bzung ste// mtshan phyed bar la gdab pa'o// 'di yi rim pas byed bdun po// lan brgyad bskor rjes bkra shis sogs// tha ma bzhi po lan cig 'byung*// gza' tshes skar ma sbyor ba dang*// byed pa dang ni yan lag lnga'o// sgra gcan zla ba rnam dag la// srin bu gzung bsre mig gis bsgyur// zla bar gcig bsre nyi mar lag /mkha' dus chu bos rnyed pa dor// lhag ma 'khor los bsgyur ba la// dkyil 'khor gyis thob skar ma yin// lhag ma rim bzhin mkha' ro dang*// drug cu dang ni ros bsnun nas// rnyed pa chu tshod chu srang dbugs// de ni 'khor lo la sbyangs pa'i// lhag ma mun can de la ni// 'khor lo phyed bsres dus kyi me// phyed dag dbyu gur bzhi bcu gnyis// chu srang tshes dang dbugs su bzhi// byin pas zla ba drug par 'gyur// sgra gcan legs par bstan zin to// gza' lnga rtogs par bya ba'i phyir// zla ba dag pa sum cus bsgyur// 'das pa'i tshes bsre gnas gsum bzhag

/steng dbus me dang nor zla bsre// 'og tu chu zlas sbyangs pa la// ri mkha' ris thob dbus su sbyin// chu ros thob pas steng la dbrog /gnas gnyis 'og ma ris bgos lhag /tshes de'i gza' dang mtshungs na dag /mi mtshungs steng mar snon 'brid kyis// mtshungs par byas pa gsal zhag yin// de la mig dmar don du ni// me dang mi bdag rnam bsres nas// ri klu dus kyis rnyed pa dor// gza' lhag spyi nyi brgya yis bsgyur// nyi zla me dang mig gis sbyang*// ri bug ri klus rnyed pa dor// phur bu zla mig gzung re bsre// de la so me rgya mtshos dbye// pa sangs don du phyogs kyis bsgyur// thub pa dus dang nyi mas sbyang*// ri rgyal mig gis rnyed pa dor// spen pa ri bug nor mda' bsre// drug ro ri mkha' zlas rnyed dor// lhag ma 'khor los bsgyur ba la// dkyil 'khor gyis thob skar ma yin// lhag ma drug cus bsgyur ba la// thob pa chu tshod lhag ma ni// mkha' ros bsgyur nas rnyed chu srang*// drug gis bsnun nas thob pa dbugs// so so'i longs spyod nges pa'o// mig dmar phur bu spen pa yi// longs spyod gnas gsum dbus ma la// bkra shis skar ma phyed bcas dgu// bla ma'i skar mar nyi ma dang*// spen pa nor zlas dbri bar bya// gza' lhag dkar po'i longs spyod dang*// ma dag nyi ma gnas gnyis kyi// gcig gi skar mar dkar po dus// lhag pa phyed bcas bcu drug sbyang*// kun gyi dal myur byed pa'i tshe// longs spyod nyi ma dal ba la// sbyong tshe 'khor lo'am de phyed kyi// sbyin dor rim min gzhan rim pa// skar gnas drug cus bsgyur la bsre// mda' yon zlas rnyed dal rkang gzung*// mig dmar de nyid skyon dang ri// gza' lhag phyogs ri rtse mo can// phur bu drug po bu ga me// pa sangs mda' dang rig byed zla// spen pa nyer gnyis tshes dang ro// kun kyang bzlog bcas dus kyi gnas// yang dag rgyu bas lhag ma bsgyur// mda' yon zlas rnyed de rtsar gzhag

/lhag ma drug cus bsgyur la bsre// rnyed pa chu srang lhag ma ni// ros bsgyur dbugs bsre rnyed pa dbugs// mtshams ma 'das na sbyin pa dang*// 'das na rim bzhin sbyang bar bya// lhag mas longs spyod nyi ma la// rim min sbyin la rim pa sbyang*// dal ba rnam par dag pa'o// dmar po bla ma spen pa yi// dal ba gnas gnyis g.yon phyogs kyi// nyi ma dag pa nyid la sbyang*// lhag dkar dal ba gnas gnyis kyi// gcig gis longs spyod la sbyangs pa'i// lhag pa'i skar mas myur rkang gzung*// mig dmar rgyal ba me mig gsum// zla mig gnas gnyis nyes tshes drag /me 'o phyi mar drag po dang*// so brgyad brgyad cu lnga bcu gsum// gza' lhag rgyal po mi bdag tshes// yid dang 'dod pa drag po ri// mda' mkha' phyi mar rig byed drag /nyi shu nyer brgyad sum cu bzhi// phur bu phyogs bcu bu ga ro// dus ro mig zla phyi mar ni// me ro srin drag rgyal po ri// pa sangs de nyid gnas gsum dang*// rgyal ba gnas gnyis mig la gnyis// nyes tshes gdeng can phyi ma la// dus dang sum cu dgu bcu dgu// tha mar bdun cu rtsa gsum mo// spen pa dus dbang mda' chu ste// mig lag mkha'o phyi ma la// zung chu mda' dus nor me ste// kun kyang gnas gzhan bcu bzhi'o// yang dag rgyu bas chu tshod bsgyur// mkha' ros rnyed pa de rtsar gzhag /lhag ma chu srang 'og ma ni// ros bsgyur dbugs bsre rnyed pa dbugs// snga mar sbyin zhing phyi mar sbyang*// lhag mas dal ba g.yas phyogs la// rim min bu lon rim pa nor// myur ba rnam par dag pa'o// de ltar dal myur gzhan yang ni// drang 'khyog 'gros rnams legs shes pas// bkra shis zla skyes bla ma dang*// dkar po dal ba rtogs par 'gyur// blo gros rin chen las byung ba'i// legs bshad 'od zer dri med phreng*// mi shes mun pa bsal phyir spros// mkhyen pa'i ye shes rgyas gyur cig

/yan lag lnga bsdus sgra gcan gza' lnga dang bcas pa rnams/ tshig nyung ngus bde blag tu rtogs par byed pa/ rin po che'i 'od zer dri ma med pa zhes bya ba/ shākya'i dge tshul blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos sa mo bya'i lo la sbyar ba yongs su rdzogs so// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
